content: A student must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in each registered course (Lectures, Tutorials, and Practicals considered separately) to be eligible to appear in the End Semester Examination (EST). If attendance is between 65% and 74.9%, relaxation may be considered solely on medical grounds (backed by Health Centre OPD/indoor slip submitted within 3 working days) or official representation in University events approved by DOAA. Students with attendance below 65% are strictly debarred and awarded an 'F' or 'X' grade (Attendance Back) and must re-register the course.

section_title: Section 7.1 - Letter Grading and CGPA Calculation
content: Evaluation uses a 10-point scale: A+ (10), A (10), A- (9), B (8), B- (7), C (6), C- (5), D (4), E (2), F (0). SGPA (Semester Grade Point Average) is calculated as Sum(Credits * Grade Points) / Sum(Credits). CGPA is the cumulative weighted average over all completed semesters. Minimum CGPA required for undergraduate degree award is 4.50. Students with SGPA below 4.00 are placed on Academic Probation. Dean's Honour List requires SGPA >= 9.00 with minimum 16 credits and zero backlogs.

A student missing the Mid Semester Test (MST) or End Semester Test (EST) due to severe illness (requiring hospitalization verified by University Chief Medical Officer) or demise of an immediate family member may apply for a Makeup Examination. Application must be submitted to the Dean of Academic Affairs (DOAA) within 5 working days of the conclusion of exams along with hospital records. A processing fee of Rs 1,000 per course applies. Makeup exams are conducted once per semester prior to the next term.

issuing_body: Office of Dean of Academic Affairs
content: Key Academic Dates for Academic Year 2024-2025: Odd Semester classes started August 5, 2024. Mid Semester Tests (MST): October 7 to October 12, 2024. End Semester Tests (EST): December 2 to December 14, 2024. Winter Break: December 16, 2024 to January 5, 2025. Even Semester begins: January 6, 2025. Even Semester Mid Semester Tests: March 10 to March 15, 2025. Even Semester End Semester Tests: May 5 to May 17, 2025. Summer Break begins May 19, 2025.

document_title: TIET Hostel Regulations & Code of Conduct 2024
section_title: Hostel Entry Timings and Appliance Regulations
content: Hostel entry curfew is 10:30 PM across all TIET hostels (Hostels A, B, C, D, E, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, PG, Q). Biometric attendance is mandatory at hostel turnstiles between 9:30 PM and 10:30 PM. Any entry after 10:30 PM triggers parent notification SMS and requires warden slip. High-wattage heating appliances (immersion rods, induction plates, room heaters) are strictly prohibited and incur an immediate fine of Rs 5,000. Desert coolers are allowed during summer months only with official warden permission stamp and Rs 1,500 electricity fee.

section_title: Borrowing Limits, Timings and Overdue Fines
content: Nava Nalanda Central Library operates from 8:00 AM to 12:00 Midnight on all working days, and 24 hours during MST and EST exam periods. Undergraduate students can issue up to 4 books for a duration of 14 days. Reference books, journals, and thesis dissertations are for reading room use only. Late return fine is Rs 5 per day per book for the first 7 days, and Rs 10 per day thereafter. Book bank scheme provides semester-long textbook access for eligible scholarship students.

document_title: Notice: Even Semester 2025 Registration and Fee Notice
section_title: Important Deadlines for Fee Payment and Course Registration
content: All undergraduate and postgraduate students must pay the Even Semester 2024-25 tuition and hostel fee through the online portal by December 20, 2024 to avoid late fee penalties. Late payment with a surcharge of Rs 2,000 will be permitted until December 28, 2024. Course enrollment on Webkiosk opens January 2, 2025 and closes January 5, 2025. Failure to pay fees by January 5, 2025 will lead to de-registration from classes.

document_title: Notice: Minor Degree and Elective Allocation 2024
section_title: Minor Degree Eligibility and Selection Criteria
content: Students entering Semester 5 with a minimum CGPA of 7.00 and zero active backlogs are eligible to apply for Minor Degrees in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Finance, or Robotics. Applications open November 20, 2024 and close on November 30, 2024 via the Academic Affairs portal. Selected students will take 20 additional credits across Semesters 5 through 8.
